description: Run a read-only SOQL query (SELECT only — DML, FOR UPDATE/VIEW/REFERENCE and multiple statements are rejected). Without LIMIT a LIMIT of 200 is added, a larger LIMIT is capped at 2000; follows nextRecordsUrl up to max_records. Use describe_salesforce_object for field names. Example: SELECT Name, StageName, Amount FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false ORDER BY CloseDate.
name: query_salesforce
